_note: Selectors verified live on SIT. otc-bo is the Back Office web app (Playwright). bfg-otc-app is the React Native member app, which ships Android + iOS + web from one codebase — its identifiers are platform-neutral, with per-platform overlays. The BO web app exposes NO data-testid attributes; every otc-bo locator is role+name, CSS, or attribute-based.

memberDetails._tabNote: rc-tabs-0 prefix is generated; prefer getByRole('tab', { name: 'Withdrawal Accounts' })

withdrawalAccounts._subTabNote: These are BUTTONs with role=tab inside 'flex items-center gap-0 border-none w-fit rounded-lg bg-gray-200 p-0.5' — a toggle pair, NOT stacked sections
withdrawalAccounts._cryptoSortNote: Only 'Created Date' is user-sortable on the Crypto Addresses table.

balanceApprovals._note: Ant Design drawer titled 'Balance Details'. Approve/Reject both enabled on a Pending request. Existing Pending withdrawals have toAddress=null (Destination Address '-') so they are not linked to a saved destination record.

bfg-otc-app._note: React Native + Expo (SDK 57) member app. app.config declares platforms: ios, android, web — one codebase, so `screens` below is platform-neutral and each platform block holds only what genuinely differs (query syntax, coordinates, launch/reset commands).
bfg-otc-app._build: app-release.apk — package com.bfgto.sit.app, versionName 0.15.0 (versionCode 1), minSdk 24 / targetSdk 36

_verifiedOn.android: 2026-08-26 — full login flow walked live on AVD pixel6
_verifiedOn.ios: NOT VERIFIED — no simulator build walked yet
_verifiedOn.web: NOT VERIFIED — no URL walked yet

_prefixes.id=: RN testID. Surfaces as resource-id (Android, no package prefix), accessibilityIdentifier (iOS), data-testid (web). SAME string on all three.
_prefixes.desc=: RN accessibilityLabel. Surfaces as content-desc (Android), accessibilityLabel (iOS), aria-label (web).
_prefixes.text=: Visible on-screen text. Same on all platforms barring locale.

bfg-otc-app._resolutionOrder: id > desc > text > coordinate. Coordinates are Android-only, a last resort for nodes with no id/desc, and valid ONLY at the resolution they were measured at.
bfg-otc-app._testIdCoverage: Sparse. Only password-toggle, otp-cell-0..5, home-header-notification-btn and home-header-unread-dot carry a testID. Everything else falls back to desc or text.
bfg-otc-app._textCaveat: A text input's `text` holds the PLACEHOLDER while empty and the typed value once filled. Match on placeholder only to find an empty field.

envGate._note: SIT environment unlock, NOT product behaviour and not in the spec. One-time per INSTALL; email is aq@aq.com. Survives logout — only clearing app data brings it back. Captured by coordinate before the testID sweep, so id/desc are unconfirmed.
envGate.title: text=Login

welcome._note: Landing screen after logout, and after the env gate on a fresh install.
welcome.title: text=Welcome

login._note: Heading 'Welcome back' / 'Log in to your account'. CTA reads 'Log in' (two words) — the Welcome screen's reads 'Login'. An exact-text locator will hit the wrong screen.

otp._note: Heading 'Verify your identity'. The six cells carry real testIDs but are NOT clickable — focus the first, then send all six digits at once; they auto-advance and the screen self-submits on the sixth.

passcode._note: One-time setup, first login per DEVICE. 'Create passcode' then 'Confirm your passcode', 6 digits each — use the standing default 111111 for both. Enrolled per device, not per account, so a later login on the same device skips it. Captured by coordinate before the testID sweep, so id/desc are unconfirmed.

home._note: Post-login landing. The three action buttons are unlabelled — identified by the TextView beneath each, so they are coordinate-only on Android until a testID is added.

account._note: Account tab. Log out sits at the bottom, behind two full swipes. Confirming opens a bottom sheet whose button ALSO answers to desc=Log out — disambiguate by position.

android._query: uiautomator dump exposes testID as resource-id with NO package prefix (e.g. 'password-toggle', not 'com.bfgto.sit.app:id/password-toggle'). Appium: id / accessibility id.
android._launchNote: `monkey -p com.bfgto.sit.app` does NOT work — it exits -5 with no error.
android._resetNote: Also the fix when the splash hangs forever on a corrupt okhttp DiskLruCache. Costs the env gate and the passcode, not the account.
android.dump: adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/ui.xml && adb shell cat /sdcard/ui.xml
android._tapNote: Node centres at 1080x2400 ONLY. Re-measure on any other resolution — do not scale blindly.
android._homeActionNote: deposit/convert/withdraw are the unlabelled Buttons at y=600; their labels sit in TextViews at y=704.
android._accountScrollNote: adb shell input swipe 540 1900 540 700 400, twice, puts Log out at 540,1968.
android._clearFieldNote: Tap the field, KEYCODE_MOVE_END, then N x KEYCODE_DEL. `input text` takes @ and ! unescaped.

ios._status: NOT VERIFIED — nothing captured. The `screens` block above should mostly hold, since testID maps to accessibilityIdentifier and accessibilityLabel is shared, but none of it has been confirmed on a simulator.
ios._needed: an iOS build (.app/.ipa) or a running simulator; bundleIdentifier is com.bfgto.sit.app per app.config
ios._query: XCUITest/Appium: id = accessibilityIdentifier (the testID), name/label = accessibilityLabel
ios._expectedDifferences: No coordinate reuse — different screen geometry. Navigation-bar back button is a real UIButton, not Android's 'Navigate up'. The system keyboard differs, so field-clearing keyevents do not transfer.

web._status: NOT VERIFIED — nothing captured. app.config declares web as a target, but no URL has been walked and it is unconfirmed whether a web build of the member app is deployed on SIT at all.
web._needed: the SIT URL for the member web app (distinct from BO_URL, which is the Back Office)
web._query: Playwright: [data-testid='...'] for testID, [aria-label='...'] for accessibilityLabel, getByText for visible text
web._expectedDifferences: No coordinates. react-native-web renders testID as data-testid. The env gate and passcode steps may not exist on web at all — device-scoped setup does not map to a browser.

api.responseShape: { code, result: { list: [], total, pageNum, pageSize, ... } }
api._profileIdNote: bank-account/crypto-address endpoints take result.profileId from identification/applicant/{memberId}, NOT the memberId in the page URL.
api._privilegeNote: user/me returns result.privileges. MEMBER_BANK_ACCOUNT_UPDATE and MEMBER_CRYPTO_ADDRESS_UPDATE are held by maiadmin@, maimaker@ and maichecker@ alike; all three report businessRoleCode ADMIN.
